title: Two hands
brief:
Two arms, one program each. Both start together when you press **Run**.

1. **Left arm**: carry the blue block to the **middle pad**, then get out of the way.
2. **Right arm**: move the block from the middle pad to the **right pad**. Use **Wait for each other** (in *Together*) so it only reaches in after the left arm has left.
3. Finish with both arms at `ready`, then one **Move together** to `ready.low`: the left arm leads, the right arm follows.
hints: Each arm has its own positions: the left arm’s `middle` and the right arm’s `middle` are the same spot, seen from each arm.
Put a “Wait for each other” in both programs: after the left arm leaves the pad, and before the right arm reaches for it.
Drop “Move together” into the left arm’s program; the right arm gets a matching “Follow” on the same row.
